candidates.description: This feature vector represents past-tense verbs indicating actions, assignments, or establishments.
This vector represents temporal adverbs, qualifiers, and directional terms indicating time, origin, or spatial orientation.
This vector is related to financial transactions, monetary funds, and economic investments.
This vector represents common French grammatical words, including frequent prepositions, auxiliary verbs, and conjunctions.
This vector represents temporal prepositions and adverbs indicating relative sequence or time, such as "after," "before," "later," and their equivalents in multiple languages.
This vector represents visual and literary artists, their creative works, and the overarching concept of fine art.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to inclusion, containment, and comprising elements.
This vector is related to physical and creative works, structures, and organized bodies of design or writing.
This feature vector activates on terms related to the physical or operational restoration, updating, and historical preservation of buildings, products, or institutions.
This vector represents German auxiliary, modal, and common copula verbs in various inflected forms.
